correctness.rationale: For the REPAIRED claim only, use the established corner-exponential product law to derive mu=P^3/(4R) and v=3P^4(a²+b²+c²)/(16R²) by the sine law. Thus R, e2 are fixed; Heron and abc=4RA imply e3²+8PR²e3−R²(4P²e2−P^4)=0. This polynomial strictly increases on positive e3, so its displayed positive root is unique and the Vieta cubic recovers the three sides for all nondegenerate triangles. P(t)=4(1+t)sqrt(1−t²), R=1 has two noncongruent isosceles P=5 triangles with identical first moment; hence two moments are minimal. Independently computed for (3,4,5): mu=864/5, v=31104, e2=47, e3=60. This is not a new proof of the known forward limit law.
